name: hunyuanvideo1.5_720p_i2v_fp16
role: Video engine, opt-in for hero shots. LTX-2.3 remains the route.
desc: Rendered and measured on this box 2026-08-18. 261 s for a 49-frame 720p clip against LTX-2.3's 28 s for the same shot - 9x the cost. It does not win overall: over four keyframes LTX takes one clean win, Hunyuan none, three split. What it does win is the hero shot. On `laces` - two hands, fine detail, shallow focus - it held the keyframe at drift 0.155 against LTX's 0.605, and it is the only engine here that never darkened a plate (mean luma_drop -0.026, i.e. slightly brighter than the frame it was given; LTX -0.003).
strengths: Holds an approved keyframe through fine detail better than LTX on close product/hand work. Smoother motion distribution - mean evenness 0.665 against 0.532, which is the number that maps to 'non fluid, lurching'. Does not darken the plate.
weaknesses: 9x slower than LTX-2.3 for the same shot, which rules it out as a default for anything longer than a few beats. No audio track, where LTX generates one. n=4 - the sample is small and the shot-to-shot spread is wider than the difference between engines.

evidence.method: 4-keyframe A/B against LTX-2.3 through studio/_tools/engine_ab.py, same prompt/seed/length/resolution, scored with clipmetrics
evidence.note: n=4. Clean wins (lower drift AND higher evenness on the same shot): LTX 1, Hunyuan 0, split 3. Means favour Hunyuan on drift (0.392 vs 0.429) and evenness (0.665 vs 0.532) by less than the shot-to-shot spread, at 9x the wall clock. Not routed. Clips and strips in ~/shared/AB/honest.
